name: Dominoes
hook: Match the ends. Empty your hand. First to 100.
how: Play a tile that matches a number at either end of the line; no match, draw from the boneyard. Empty your hand to win the round and score every pip left in the other hands. First to 100 points wins.
controls: Click or tap a tile to play it (tap an end if it fits both), tap the boneyard to draw
uses: Your hand is sealed so only you can read it (the host deals, so it can too).
The host's browser shuffles, deals and checks every tile; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots fill empty seats and take over for anyone who leaves.
Points won, added up over every round, shown after each round.
ideas: Score only rounds that end on a multiple of five
Use a double-nine set for bigger games
Make the tiles glow like neon on a dark table
